# Third-party sources used by the demos

Small files taken from the companion repositories of the *Assembling Smart CPS* book
([AssemblingSmartCPS](https://github.com/AssemblingSmartCPS)), kept here so the lab does not need to clone them:

| Path | Origin | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `ch19/server.py`, `client.py`, `*.csv` | `ch19` (federated learning chapter) | Flower server strategy, and the per-client / test datasets |
| `ch14/weather_web_server.py` | `ch14/demos` (plugins and services chapter) | the weather thing exposed through WSTUN |

Line endings were normalised; no other change. Original authorship and licensing remain those of the upstream
repositories.
